title: Every nonempty real open interval contains a rational number
statement: Use the fields $\mathbf Q,\mathbf R$ [def-weil-field], with the usual inclusion $\mathbf Q\hookrightarrow\mathbf R$. For real numbers $a<b$ there is $q\in\mathbf Q$ with $a<q<b$.
